Q230.cannot: The question asks whether the store's bank account reconciles cleanly with the tills. The upi-settlements-june table only records UPI settlement amounts (gross, refunds, MDR, net) per day. It does not contain any information about the store's bank account balance, bank statements, or total till takings (which include cash and card payments from pos-payments-june). Reconciling the bank account with the tills requires comparing the bank's record of all credits (UPI + card + cash deposits) against the sum of all approved payments at the tills. Since the bank account data and the full set of approved payments across all tenders are not available in a single table, no one table can answer this.

Q231.cannot: No column in psp-upi-report-june or upi-settlements-june links a UPI transaction (rrn) to a daily settlement row. Settlements are per-day aggregates (gross, mdr, net, refunds, credits) without rrn, so we cannot tell which individual rrn failed to settle.

Q232.cannot: The records do not contain the payment app (Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm) used for UPI transactions. pos-payments-june records only the tender 'UPI' and psp-upi-report-june records provider status but not the app. Therefore timeout rate by app cannot be computed.

Q233.cannot: No table records a customer's phone number or UPI VPA. The payment tables (pos-payments-june, psp-upi-report-june) contain rrn, amount, bill_id and status, but no customer identity or VPA. The complaints table (customer-complaints-june) has rrn and bill_id but no contact details. The ontology states: 'A bill stands in for a shopper. There is no customer identity.'

Q234.cannot: Demand is not recorded; only sales of the eleven followed items are recorded. Price elasticity requires demand data, which is not available in the records.

Q235.cannot: No table records promotions, discounts, or their attribution to sales. The records hold only sales, stock, payments, and operations for eleven followed items; there is no promotion code, discount flag, or campaign identifier to evaluate.

Q236.cannot: Profitability requires total revenue and total cost for the store. Records cover only 11 followed products (daily-sales-june, pos-lines-may-june) and their per-unit cost (products.cost_inr). Revenue and cost for all other products, plus overheads (rent, labour, utilities, etc.), are not recorded.

Q237.cannot: Real purchase costs, rebates and freight per unit are not recorded. Only a single cost_inr per product exists in products, which is a list cost, not the actual landed cost with rebates and freight.

Q238.cannot: Shelf space per product (square feet) is not recorded in any table. Products table has pack size and case dimensions but not shelf allocation. Sales and revenue data exist for the 11 followed items, but without shelf area per SKU, revenue per square foot cannot be computed.

Q239.cannot: No record of shelf camera cost, installation cost, maintenance cost, or any revenue or cost saving attributed to a shelf camera. Lost sales (demand at an empty shelf) are not recorded.
